preconditions.description: The length of the serial number n must be between 1 and 100000.
The total number of changes and checks must be between 1 and 100000.

preconditions.expression: len(serial_number) == n and all(c in '0123456789' for c in serial_number)
preconditions.description: The serial number must have a length equal to n and consist only of digits from 0 to 9.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= l <= r <= n for l, r in changes_and_checks)
preconditions.description: All changes and checks must have valid indices l and r within the bounds of the serial number.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= c <= 9 for c in changes)
preconditions.description: All change values c must be digits from 0 to 9.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= d <= r - l + 1 for l, r, d in checks)
preconditions.description: All check periods d must be valid for the corresponding substrings.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' if all(s[i] == s[i + d] for i in range(l - 1, r - d)) else 'NO'
postconditions.description: For each check, output 'YES' if the substring from l to r has period d, otherwise output 'NO'.
